title: Grateful Dead Live at Glens Falls Civic Center on 1982-04-14

ai_review.summary: Decent matrix recording with some delay and hot‑vocals issues, but the show shines thanks to a smoking TLEO and a tasty China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised as a good, high‑energy set highlighted by an especially smoking TLEO and a long, tasty China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider stretch. The matrix mix is usable but suffers from noticeable time‑delay on Jerry’s lead in TLEO and the typical hot‑vocal/low‑bass quirks of early‑80s SBD sources.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is consistently rated positively (4‑star level) while recording quality receives mixed feedback, pulling the weighted average to a solid but not outstanding score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Matrix mix has noticeable time‑delay on Jerry's lead during TLEO (min 5‑6) and exhibits the typical hot vocals, bright keyboards and reduced bass found in many 1981‑82 SBD recordings; overall still listenable.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth transitions with a particularly long, tasty jam into Rider; the set maintains strong momentum throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Raspy vocal tone praised; lead guitar on TLEO noted as tasty but suffers from delay in the matrix mix.
